svg.title: A visibly composite meeting of functional roles
svg.desc: Use ordinary meeting geometry and a prominent continuous composite disclosure. Functional roles share the table; no venue insignia or recognizable likeness should imply a particular real meeting. Use the broken conference envelope and blank presentation board, with the existing composite disclosure retained.
